metadata.case_name: CHIMMALEE ON-UMA v. WAYLUNG WASTE SERVICES LIMITED

injuries.description: she sprained her back and therefore sustained injuries.
source: she sprained her back and therefore sustained injuries.
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of lumbar spine

injuries.description: a prolapsed intervertebral disc at L4/5 causing bilateral lateral recessive stenosis.
source: MRI scan was performed which showed a prolapsed intervertebral disc at L4/5 causing bilateral lateral recessive stenosis.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the abdomen, lower back, lumbar spine or pelvis

injuries.description: pre-existing degeneration of the cervical and lumbar spine with degenerative spurs present in both regions.
source: the plaintiff had pre-existing degeneration of the cervical and lumbar spine with degenerative spurs present in both regions.

manifestations.description: constantly over the back - spinal area
tingling sensation of her upper limbs, which radiates from her neck to fingers on both sides
tingling sensation of both lower limbs, which radiates from her hip to her toes on both sides
pain over her neck and shoulder with pins and needle-like sensation
sense of numbness over both buttocks
difficulty in swallowing / frequent sense of choking
both eye pain with disturbed vision, blurring of vision and diplopia
limited sitting and standing tolerance and limited trunk flexibility due to pain
need for walking stick when walking in public area (from August 2005)

treatments_received: admitted to the Accident and Emergency Ward of the North District Hospital for emergency treatment
attendance at Orthopaedics and Traumatology Department of North District Hospital
Shek Wu Hui Jockey Club Clinic treatment
28 outpatient physiotherapy follow-up treatments at North District Hospital between 8 May 2004 and 2 June 2006
15 physiotherapy sessions between 27 July 2004 and 3 November 2004 (lumbar traction, electrotherapy, heat therapy, active and passive back mobilizing exercises)
4 physiotherapy sessions between 14 March 2006 and 25 May 2006
12 sessions of work rehabilitation therapy at OTD of NDH between 22 November 2005 and 6 January 2006
referred to pain clinic of Alice Ho Miu Ling Nethersole Hospital and received four sessions of physiotherapy
treatment by Hung Shu Sum Bonesetter, two other private practitioners and a registered China Herbalist
treatments_future: occasional physiotherapy if activities produce exacerbation of back pain (opinion of Dr Chien)
back exercises to improve strength and flexibility of the spine (recommendation of Dr Ho)

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: since the accident, plaintiff can no longer enjoy leisure activities including swimming, jogging and walking in the parks.

comparable_cases.case_name: Law King Sang v Law Yin Sang
comparable_cases.injury_description: plaintiff sprained his back and could not sit or stand for long periods or swim or lift heavy objects.
